notes_for_editor: Sources agree on the 1926 crow's nest, the 1928 log cabin with cupola and the destruction around 1950. Location conflict in the brief is unresolved: the record uses the FFLA point (45.88644, -114.92982), while the Idaho Fire Lookouts point is 45.89129, -114.93546; no page read gives coordinates. Harry Farris is listed with no year, so no staffing date is taken from him. The far-right '1920s' entry on the Forest Service row sits in a column whose heading is unclear in the text, so it is not used; the 1926 crow's nest is in the build-date column of the Grouse Ridge row. Photo: the Forest Service history PDF has a caption 'Grouse Ridge LO, no date' credited to a Sid Poppe photo in the Dick Walker Collection, but it has no image URL, so it was not added; the record already has an Idaho Fire Lookouts photo.
